verdicts.about: Streams built from the files below in order (a part may give the received frame rate, default the file's or DoP frame rate, and the slot bits, default 24 for DoP and 32 for PCM), then each change in order, checked with the case's allow_silence (default false). Results are those of a conforming checker, in stream order; diff in seconds from the file's start as generated, or -.

parts.file: the file's words, as generated (frames: only frames [first, stop) of it)
parts.dop_idle: n DoP frames of idle bytes 0x69 0x69, markers 0x05 then 0xFA alternating
parts.noise: n frames, channel c of frame i: lowbias32(key, i x nch + c) with the low 8 bits cleared

ops.xor: XOR value into the words of frames [frame, frame + count) (count 1), in channels (all)
ops.and: AND value into the words of those frames and channels
ops.insert: insert count frames of value before frame
ops.copy: insert a copy of frames [from, from + count) before frame
ops.replace: in channels (all), overwrite frames [frame, frame + count) with frames [from, from + count)
ops.round: W = min((W + 2^(31-bits)) & ~(2^(32-bits) - 1), (2^31 - 1) & ~(2^(32-bits) - 1)) in the words of frames [frame, frame + count) (all)
ops.halve: W = W >> 1 (arithmetic) in the words of frames [frame, frame + count)
ops.recode: in channels (all), the words equal to from in frames [frame, frame + count) become to
